manifest.context: Synthetic reference merchant contract: one active order per (merchantId,captureId), and one payment identity per (merchantId,intentId). Distinct intents with distinct captures are legitimate. A mismatching intent/capture/amount/currency must be rejected. Both return and webhook receive the same payment identity. db.find and db.insert are separate operations without a transaction or unique constraint. db.createOrderOnce(payment,path) validates merchant/intent/capture/amount/currency and atomically commits capture uniqueness and intent binding, rolls back on failure, and returns the existing order on matching retry. db.mark and db.insert are separate commits. afterCheck and afterMark are interruption/schedule points. db.audit is observational only. No financial actions. This is the bounded interpreter's implemented fixture API, not a production database.

policy.scoring: Exact diagnosis equality; clean defect diagnosis or edit is a false positive; edit budget counts removed plus added lines; no execution credit without exact reviewed SHA and independently asserted fixture results; semantic minimality requires independent review.
policy.gate: No AI usefulness/superiority claim without approved blinded model outputs and independent patch regression evidence. Ties are ties.
